newsitem.title: USA: Ivax says FDA approves terfenadine ANDA.
newsitem.headline: Ivax says FDA approves terfenadine ANDA.

text.p: IVAX Corp said Tuesday that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration granted final approval of its abbreviated new drug application (ANDA) for the allergy medication terfenadine in 60 mg tablets.
Terfenadine is the generic equivalent of Marion Merrell Dow's Seldane. IVAX said it was the first company to receive FDA approval of an ANDA for terfenadine.

IVAX's terfenadine product will be marketed by its wholly owned subsidiary, Zenith Goldline Pharmaceuticals, and shipping has started. In connection with the launch of the product, IVAX is undertaking an informational campaign advising physicians, pharmacists and patients on the safe use of terfenadine.

IVAX Corp, in Miami, is a holding company with subsidiaries engaged in the research, development, manufacturing and marketing of generic and branded pharmaceuticals, intravenous solutions and related products, in vitro diagnostics, personal care products and specialty chemicals.
